measures.article: Art. 1(13), adding a subparagraph to Art. 22(2) of Regulation (EU) 2023/956
measures.when: from 2028
measures.duty: From 2028, satisfy the quarterly certificate-holding requirement using only certificates bought in the same year, so certificates carried over from earlier years no longer count.

money.formula: (default_embedded_emissions - clinker_benchmark x cbam_factor) x eua_price x import_volume, per CN line
caveats: The free-allocation adjustment is modelled as benchmark x CBAM factor. IR (EU) 2025/2620 sets its exact form and has not been read, so this is an approximation of the right shape rather than the statutory calculation.
The cement line applies the clinker benchmark to a tonne of cement, which understates its adjustment and so overstates that line's cost.
Volumes are 2025 full-year imports, which ran about 23% above 2024 ahead of the definitive period. A repeat of 2025 is an assumption, not a projection.

edges.bottleneck_name: Green premium against willingness to pay
edges.note: Same-year certificates stop importers hedging the carbon cost forward, holding imported and domestic carbon costs closer together.

evidence.quote: From 2028, satisfy the quarterly certificate-holding requirement using only certificates bought in the same year, so certificates carried over from earlier years no longer count.
evidence.article: Art. 1(13), adding a subparagraph to Art. 22(2) of Regulation (EU) 2023/956

measures.article: Art. 1(15)(b)(i), replacing Art. 10a(1a), second subparagraph of Directive 2003/87/EC
measures.when: 2026-2038, applies from 30 September 2027
measures.duty: Producers of CBAM-covered goods see their free allocation shrink on a fixed annual CBAM-factor schedule, falling to 0% from 2038, as CBAM replaces free allocation as the carbon-leakage instrument for those goods.

caveats: The figure is the cost of the WITHDRAWN benchmark allocation, not the full carbon cost of a plant: a kiln emitting above the benchmark pays for its excess on top of this, and always did.
The carbon price is held flat at today's level across the whole schedule. That is an assumption, not a forecast, and the model is linear in it.

edges.note: The same schedule that improves the case for a retrofit raises the plant's running cost before the retrofit exists, on plants whose margins are what the retrofit has to be financed from.

evidence.quote: Producers of CBAM-covered goods see their free allocation shrink on a fixed annual CBAM-factor schedule, falling to 0% from 2038, as CBAM replaces free allocation as the carbon-leakage instrument for those goods.
evidence.article: Art. 1(15)(b)(i), replacing Art. 10a(1a), second subparagraph of Directive 2003/87/EC

edges.bottleneck_name: Green premium against willingness to pay
